trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: No separate task: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Work the roadmap in order and save this one for last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story, cannot miss: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing with Jason. It pops as the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story: finish Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start in case you want to revisit anything.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story: finish Chapter 2. It pops with the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story: finish Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story: finish Chapter 4. The bank vaults open up in this chapter, so start Maximum Withdrawal here.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story: finish the final mission. After it, free roam stays open, so nothing is missable afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story: complete the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story: complete the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story: complete the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story: complete the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The grind: finish the 100% completion checklist under Progress, Stats, after the story. You only need about 60% of true completion — the thresholds are lenient, so skip the hardest leftovers. Track it in the Stages view.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts out of 397 across Leonida — jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights, base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest kind. The 100% checklist wants 300, so you will pass 250 on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: racing, fishing, hunting, arcade, pool, mini golf, basketball, shooting range, drone racing. One try each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Take your time and learn each range's rhythm; the checklist needs all 42 as well.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total. The checklist wants all 42 time trials done, so finish the races and the trials together.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; the 100% checklist wants 30 of 40, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing unlocks early; challenge him whenever you see the prompt.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Pick the shortest game in the arcade and finish it once.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Start Andy's strand as soon as it appears and follow it to the end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand also feeds the treasure sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Stranger mission strands across Leonida. Start each strand as soon as it unlocks — TechWiser warns some have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's strand to the end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's strand to the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Do the FIRST one in Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her balcony invitation — it may disappear once Chapter 1 ends. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal is still unconfirmed — check Bret's Target Deck and take the hunt it offers.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this pops early in the hunt.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures. Scan everything unfamiliar from the start — the checklist wants the same 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The checklist wants 70, so leave the 10 hardest for last and finish 50 on the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, reach a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the heat. Both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia; bank vault robberies also bring the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. North Vice City's jewelry stores sit close together; if it doesn't pop after the third, GTABase says rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan them with WAiNK — you don't need to drive them. Busy roads give you traffic to scan fast.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus first with food, drinks or a shower, bring Adrenaline and an assault rifle, and aim at gang members — cops, soldiers and civilians don't count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft at Vice City International Airport. GTABase: take a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. GTABase: take one from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Open the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and clear the safe without anyone spotting you.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open in Chapter 4 with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open, expect 4 stars, and keep a fast bike ready. The checklist wants 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit one on the road, grab the cash and break line of sight before the wanted level sticks.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Flying over the dark patches is the fastest way to clear the fog.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. GTABase lists the gangs; work through them one by one.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed — PowerPyx marks it not yet known, so check back before chasing it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. GTABase thinks it means crashing a car out through a showroom window, but that is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Keeengamer: steal the three key valuables there and escape — the wording is still unclear, so treat it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. GTABase: train Strength for both characters until it caps.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. GTABase links it to the Criminal Profile; a single source, so the count may be refined.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The method is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange out in Leonida. GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in the state; unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through contacts. One fence pays the most, per GTABase; the total grows during the 100% robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles and weapons add up quickly.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties (about $160,000 in total via the Vice City Real Estate app). The 4 story garages don't count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Register cars you find as you explore.
